subject: MPA & eval: proposed compact schedule + commitment rescope
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@atlasdatasys.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Henderson <mike.henderson@atlasdatasys.com>, procurement@atlasdatasys.com
Date: 2027-08-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: RE: Next steps — MAP and eval window (timeline concerns)

Sergio,

Thanks for the demo last week — team is excited about the latency gains. Quick note: our legal and procurement teams pushed back on the proposed go-live date of Oct 15. Their ask is to add a 3-week window for SOC evidence review and an extra staging sign-off. That effectively moves the earliest realistic go-live to Nov 6.

We want to keep momentum but need a practical MAP that aligns with our procurement gating. Can we compress the eval plan and still keep the same acceptance criteria? Attached a procurement constraints list.

—Lena

Attachments: atlas_procurement_constraints.pdf (doc stub)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@atlasdatasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-30T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: RE: Next steps — MAP and eval window (timeline concerns)

Lena — thanks for the heads up and for the constraints doc. I copied Marissa and Karthik so we can align on commercial and risk mitigations.

Quick proposal:
- Trim the full 4-week eval to a focused 2-week acceptance sprint (key tests only). I attached a compact eval plan (eval_plan_trim.xlsx) with pass/fail gates.
- Move non-critical integration items to a Phase 2 post-go-live backlog (e.g., SSO deep audit).
- Provide SOC evidence snapshot within 5 business days of your request; if you need full SOC 2 Type II reports we can route to legal but propose acceptance can proceed on the snapshot + audit schedule.

If Atlas agrees to the shortened acceptance scope and a small staging freeze window, we can preserve an Oct 22-ish commitment instead of slipping to Nov. If procurement still insists on Nov 6, we want to formalize that shift and adjust credits/rollout gates in the MPA.

Would you be open to a quick decision call today at 3pm PT? I can share the MPA v3 showing the credit and rollback ladder for a shifted close.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: eval_plan_trim.xlsx, MPA_v3.pdf

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@atlasdatasys.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Henderson <mike.henderson@atlasdatasys.com>, procurement@atlasdatasys.com
Date: 2027-08-30T13:25:00Z
Subject: Re: RE: Next steps — MAP and eval window (timeline concerns)

Thanks — appreciate the compact plan. Two clarifying points from procurement: 1) they require a 10-business-day review on any security artifacts prior to acceptance (that pushes any acceptance after the SOC snapshot by at least 2 weeks), and 2) they want explicit rollback credit language if Atlas cannot sign off by the postponed date.

We can do the 2-week focused eval but procurement needs the credit ladder documented in the MPA (percent-of-contract credit per week of missed acceptance). Mike (copied) will lead on legal language.

We can do a call at 3pm PT.

—Lena

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@atlasdatasys.com>, Mike Henderson <mike.henderson@atlasdatasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-30T16:05:00Z
Subject: Follow-up and internal ask: MPA credit ladder + staging window

Thanks for confirming the call, Lena. 

Recap from the 3pm PT call:
- Atlas procurement requires 10 business days for any security artifact review before final acceptance.
- Atlas wants a documented credit/rollback ladder in the MPA for missed acceptance milestones.
- Atlas will run the condensed 10-business-day (2 calendar week) acceptance tests if Redwood supplies the SOC snapshot and a prioritized test checklist.

Internal asks (looping Marissa/Karthik/Laura):
1) Legal/commercial: draft a short credit ladder clause (example attached: pricing-terms-diff.md) that scales credits 5% per week delayed after the agreed acceptance date, capped at 30% and with a restart clause for remediation patches.
2) Product/eng (Karthik): confirm we can produce a SOC snapshot package and the test harness for the condensed acceptance within 3 business days of request. If we cannot meet that, we will need to agree a non-negotiable staging freeze that moves the acceptance out.
3) CS/onsite (Laura): prepare a prioritized acceptance checklist (from eval_plan_trim.xlsx) and an abbreviated runbook for go/no-go decision gates.

Goal: either preserve an Oct 22 target with the condensed acceptance + legal credit ladder, or formally rebaseline to Nov 6 and trigger MPA updates and a one-time customer credit. Please reply with confirmations by EOD so I can update Atlas and route the MPA.

Thanks — Sergio

Attachments: pricing-terms-diff.md

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-31T09:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up and internal ask: MPA credit ladder + staging window

Sergio — I reviewed procurement's constraints. Commercial is okay to accept a tiered credit ladder but want to add a clause that credits are reclaimed if Atlas resumes acceptance within a 30-day remediation window. Karthik — can you confirm SOC snapshot feasibility? If we can deliver in 3 business days we keep Oct 22. If not, we rebaseline and I will authorize the one-time credit (estimate 12% as a negotiation buffer).

Short answers: I approve drafting the MPA update and will own the external commit. Please keep me posted; I will join the exec call if Atlas requests further escalation.

—Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-31T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up and internal ask: MPA credit ladder + staging window — SOC snapshot feasibility

Confirming product can assemble a SOC snapshot package and the reduced acceptance harness in 2 business days. We'll need a 24-hour handoff window from Atlas to begin packaging. Karthik will also provide a brief tech note for procurement outlining what the snapshot includes (logs, config manifests, scope limits).

Action items complete on our side:
- SOC snapshot (2 business days)
- Prioritized acceptance checklist (Laura) — ETA EOD tomorrow
- Legal draft (Marissa) — please prep MPA clause by tomorrow noon so Sergio can share with Atlas.

If all aligns, we will preserve Oct 22 as the committed acceptance gate. If procurement insists on Nov 6 after seeing the legal draft, we will update the MPA and apply the negotiated buffer credit.

—Karthik
